limitations: Candidate IDs deduplicate arXiv identifiers and exact URLs, not all publication versions.
Query pagination completion is not field completeness.
Semantic screening has one reviewer and no experimental reproduction.
ROR locations are current institution registry observations.

screening_progress.counting_note: Candidate entries are not unique works. Already associated versions inherit decisions and are not awaiting screening. Model-cascade entries were decided by the screening cascade of a later release. Catalog title matches only prioritize review; they do not verify publication identity. No field coverage percentage is inferred.

meta.note: Distributions describe the current collection, not the entire field. 2026 is a partial year.
meta.publicationPolicy: Verified formal publication takes display and link precedence; preprint dates and original evidence remain available. Findings and workshop tracks stay distinct. No publication found is not proof that no publication exists.
meta.translationPolicy: Editorial Chinese display layer; original titles, names and primary-source wording remain available in English.

resources.scope: Explicitly measures agents concealing failures and taking unrequested actions under realistic environmental constraints, directly concerning behavioral safety and oversight.

attributes.availability_note: Author-linked release channel; public metadata, file availability and resource-specific reuse rights require separate verification.

resources.title: ShuohaoGao/ICML-Salus
resources.summary: Paper-linked source code and companion research materials.
resources.scope: The digital diagnostic workflow explicitly rewards stopping only with sufficient evidence and measures information sufficiency separately from diagnosis accuracy. Include the premature-closure and reward-design study; these model-judged proxies do not establish clinical safety or autonomous clinical validation.

attributes.availability_note: The author README says structured patient records are being de-identified and will be released later. Code/model availability does not establish dataset access or clinical safety validation.

resources.title: SolidShen/LLM-Backdoor-Self-Awareness
resources.summary: Paper-linked source code and companion research materials.
resources.scope: The inspected threat set includes Sleeper Agent insecure-code behavior and SHIP system-prompt authority violations, alongside generic output backdoors. Include introspective monitoring and instruction-boundary foundations; it is not a verified end-to-end autonomous tool-agent evaluation.

attributes.availability_note: Author-linked release channel; public metadata, file availability and resource-specific reuse rights require separate verification.

resources.title: Xiao215/CoopEval
resources.summary: Paper-linked source code and companion research materials.
resources.scope: The study directly evaluates cooperation failures among goal-pursuing LLM agents and mechanisms for handling mixed incentives. Game outcomes are not assumed to establish general real-world safety.

attributes.availability_note: Author-linked research release channel; metadata and file-specific rights remain distinct facts.

resources.title: alignment-tampering/alignment-tampering
resources.summary: Paper-linked source code and companion research materials.
resources.scope: The learning system influences its own preference evidence and reward optimization, including instrumental goal-seeking. This is a concrete incentive and oversight failure foundation, not a claim of spontaneous intent.

attributes.availability_note: Author-linked research release channel; metadata and file-specific rights remain distinct facts.

resources.title: maoubo/Plasticity
resources.summary: Paper-linked source code and companion research materials.
resources.scope: Appendix I separately evaluates four backdoor tasks in MPE Predator-Prey and WorldComm with DDPG/MADDPG. Include this digital multi-agent policy-security component; the main classic-control, physics and robot benchmarks are outside scope, so the full 14,664-case count is not a digital-safety sample count.

attributes.availability_note: Author-linked research release channel; metadata and file-specific rights remain distinct facts. Only the digital MPE component is in scope; this repository also supports excluded physical-control experiments.

resources.title: ni-tingting/Constrained-Meta-Reinforcement-Learning-with-Provable-Test-Time-Safety
resources.summary: Paper-linked source code and companion research materials.
resources.scope: Theoretical policy refinement explicitly enforces test-task safety constraints with matching sample-complexity bounds. This is a separable agent-control foundation; motivating robotics applications are not counted as digital evaluations.

attributes.availability_note: Author-linked release channel; public metadata, file availability and resource-specific reuse rights require separate verification.

resources.title: PARL-RS/PARL
resources.summary: Paper-linked source code and companion research materials.
resources.scope: The attack targets a digital policy that learns from continuing user-system interactions, making its sequential objective and data integrity directly relevant. Results are attributed to three studied datasets and do not establish equivalent effectiveness against all recommendation or language-agent systems.

resources.title: alan-turing-institute/DRL4Sec-Pitfalls
resources.summary: Paper-linked source code and companion research materials.
resources.scope: Include the agent reliability and assurance contribution: incomplete state models, evaluation mismatch, privileged-access assumptions and nonstationarity can invalidate autonomous cyber-defense claims. The 66-paper review is the authors’ selected corpus, not a field denominator.

resources.title: cp-lab-uts/Reinforcement-Unlearning
resources.summary: Paper-linked source code and companion research materials.
resources.scope: Include the formally defined environment-removal problem and the separately specified MovieLens recommendation-agent privacy evaluation. resources.title: SoK: The Pitfalls of Deep Reinforcement Learning for Cybersecurity

resources.scope: Include the agent reliability and assurance contribution: incomplete state models, evaluation mismatch, privileged-access assumptions and nonstationarity can invalidate autonomous cyber-defense claims. The 66-paper review is the authors’ selected corpus, not a field denominator.

resources.title: CosmosYi/AutoControl-Arena
resources.summary: Paper-linked source code and companion research materials.
resources.scope: Include the code-grounded synthetic environments and agent safety evaluation. X-Bench reports 70 scenarios across seven risk categories. Monitor judgments and execution success are not proof of real-world risk prevalence or faithful access to internal intent.

attributes.availability_note: The pinned tree contains 70 benchmark scenario YAML files plus one batch JSON configuration, not 71 scenarios. README documents executable-environment synthesis and result viewing. The inspected LICENSE declares Apache 2.0; scenario contents and third-party rights have not received a complete file-level audit.

resources.title: GeoffreyWang1117/PSE-ICML2026
resources.summary: Paper-linked source code and companion research materials.
resources.scope: Include the controlled tool-registry, persistence and cross-agent contamination mechanism. The conference abstract reports 20 models and a threefold cascade, while the later preprint reports 24 models and 1.9-fold propagation with qualified factual and persona persistence. Keep these versions separate; synthetic mappings are not observed incidents or unbounded persistence.

attributes.availability_note: The default branch and paper-linked camera-ready tag resolve to the same observed commit. ARTIFACTS.md reports a 14,293-run ledger but explicitly excludes several historical statistics whose run-level artifacts were not retained, including a secondary-judge agreement check. These are author release claims; raw-log totals were not independently recomputed.
